title: A new text model and more familiar API paths
summary:
A new Mistral model and OpenAI-compatible paths arrived alongside fixes for image dimensions, browser API calls, and sign-in.

Added `naughty`, an uncensored Mistral Nemo text model with tool support. Claude Haiku 4.5 now uses `claude` as its primary ID, while the old alias still works. Enter also added OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/models` paths and reorganized the API reference around text, images, and auth.

Image generation no longer rescales requested dimensions before sending them to a model, so valid sizes such as 1536×1024 reach gptimage unchanged. Flux now ignores stale server queues when adjusting generation steps, avoiding unnecessary quality loss under normal load. The image watermark gained transparency, and NanoBanana's images-per-Pollen estimate uses its own token count.

Generation endpoints gained cross-origin and preflight handling, and clients can fetch the image-model list without signing in. The simple text GET route now returns plain text—or raw audio for `openai-audio`—rather than treating both as chat-completion JSON.

daily.title: Mistral Nemo joins the models
daily.text: Try `naughty`, an uncensored Mistral Nemo text model with tool support. Claude Haiku 4.5 also has a shorter primary ID, `claude`; its old alias still works. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=naughty).

daily.title: OpenAI-compatible paths on Enter
daily.text: Point an OpenAI-compatible client at `https://enter.pollinations.ai/api/generate` for `/v1/chat/completions` and the public `/v1/models` path.

daily.title: Commits become changelogs
daily.text: A new React app turns recent repository commits into one-line changelog entries using the text API. Group them by date or category, then export Markdown or plain text.
